title: Cost-Efficient Large Language Model Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with CachedAttention
technique: AttentionStore: hierarchical (HBM/DRAM/SSD) KV store for reuse across conversation turns, layer-wise pre-loading, async saving, scheduler-aware fetching/eviction, positional-encoding decoupling so truncated KV stays valid

optimized_metrics.evidence: To reduce the serving cost and improve the inference performance, this paper proposes CachedAttention
scheduler-aware fetching and eviction schemes ... candidates to be evicted for achieving a high cache hit rate

headline_claim.text: CachedAttention significantly decreases the time to the first token (TTFT) by up to 87%, improves the prompt prefilling throughput by up to 7.8x for multi-turn conversations, and reduces the end-to-end inference cost by up to 70%.

reported_metrics.where: Fig 17 total $ cost of completing the workload
Fig 16 total prefilling / decoding GPU time

metric_definitions.definition_quote: TTFT is an important metric for quality of service in LLM serving [2, 31]. It indicates how quickly users start seeing the output of LLMs after entering their prompt.
metric_definitions.notes: Informal; elsewhere equated with prefill time: 'The repetitive computation time occupies 99% of the prefilling time (a.k.a., time to the first token) in the new conversation' (§2.3). Queueing treatment not stated.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Prefilling throughput is the metric to evaluate the speed of processing the prompt.
metric_definitions.notes: Prefill-only tokens/s (input tokens including cached/reused ones presumably counted via 't/s' axis); NOT generation throughput. The 7.8x headline is this metric.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: We evaluate the resource cost based on the on-demand price of AWS EC2 instances [4, 5], i.e., $5/hour per A100 GPU, $0.0088/hour/GB for DRAM and $0.000082/hour/GB for SSD.
metric_definitions.notes: Cost = GPU-hours + DRAM + SSD storage cost to complete the workload; storage cost is small relative to GPU time saved.

load_regime: trace replay of ShareGPT multi-turn conversations; sessions interleave; compared against recomputation (RE) baseline
tradeoff_acknowledged: Storage cost of DRAM/SSD for saved KV (offset by reduced GPU time); low hit rate for LLaMA-65B (2.5 MB/token KV) limits gain; prefetch/save overheads hidden via overlap.
hardware: A100 80GB GPUs (4-8), large host DRAM and SSD
extractor_notes: Headline 'throughput' is prefill-only throughput, not end-to-end tokens/s. TTFT is treated as ~prefill time. Cost is the only paper in this batch with an explicit $ model. Only mean/average reported, no percentiles; no SLO.
load_class_quote: we generate request arrival times based on the Poisson distribution with various arrival rates (§4.1)
repass_log: TTFT (mean) and THR_TOK (prefill throughput): only abstract result / metric-definition text found, no design statement -> demoted to reported_metrics
COST: abstract result replaced by §1 design statement; cache_hit_rate: design
